sources.title: Advanced Layout Analysis Models for Docling - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: This technical report documents the development of novel Layout Analysis models integrated into the Docling document-conversion pipeline. We trained several state-of-the-art object detectors based on the RT-DETR, RT-DETRv2 and DFINE architectures on a heterogeneous corpus of 150,000 documents (both openly available and proprietary).

sources.title: GitHub - onnx/models: A collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art ...
sources.snippet: Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. This repository is a curated collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art models in the ONNX format.
